subtitle: We centralize official tourism data to help you discover heritage sites, events, gastronomy, and regional experiences.
prompt_placeholder: I want to explore Arequipa for 5 days. I am looking for historic places, traditional gastronomy, cultural events, and updated travel routes.
chapter_1_desc: Built entirely in white volcanic ashlar stone with its imposing 70-meter neoclassical Cathedral against Misti volcano.
chapter_2_desc: Monastic citadel over 20,000 m² featuring indigo blue and terracotta red cloisters, stone alleys, and ashlar courtyards.
chapter_3_desc: 19th-century ashlar arches carved with verses by Arequipeño poets offering iconic views of Misti, Chachani, and Pichu Pichu.
chapter_4_desc: Active quarries where master stonecutters carve volcanic ashlar stone into mega-carvings and full-size baroque facades.
chapter_5_desc: One of the deepest canyons on earth (over 4,160 m) featuring soaring Andean condors over pre-Inca agricultural terraces.
